purpose: Teach: 電卓/めまい/日課/美徳/二次会/失恋/老婆/バルト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お店で、絶対、電卓、絶対、いつも、絶対、使ってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know I actually use the calculator at the shop every single day, right?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slight emphasis on 'actually' — she's sharing something genuine. Steady, unhurried. A soft laugh underneath, like she's letting him in on a small truth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、立ちくらみで、絶対、めまい、絶対、しちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis… I really did get a bit dizzy and lightheaded earlier, you know?
lines.style: Quiet, earnest delivery. The words come a little carefully — he's reporting something real that happened to him. Small voice, direct. No performance, just truth-telling to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お花の水やり、絶対、毎朝の、絶対、日課、絶対、にしているわ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, watering the flowers every morning has become my daily routine, and I really do stick to it.
lines.style: Thoughtful pace, like she's reflecting as she speaks. Warm but grounded. A note of quiet pride in the small commitment. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、嘘をつかないことは、絶対、美徳、絶対、だよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, not lying is a virtue, isn't it? I mean, that's what matters, right?
lines.style: Careful, observant tone. He's working through something as he speaks. Not asking for reassurance — stating it like he's testing the truth of it. Small, thoughtful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お友達の結婚式の、絶対、二次会、絶対、楽しかったわ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, a friend's wedding after-party really was so much fun last week.
lines.style: Brighter energy than before. The memory lights her up a little. Animated but genuine — not performing joy, just remembering it. Lighter pace, more open.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、失恋、絶対、すると、絶対、辛いんでしょ?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis… when someone gets their heart broken, it must really hurt, doesn't it?
lines.style: Curious but careful. He's asking something he's thinking about. Not shy, but considerate — he genuinely wants to know. A little vulnerable in the asking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、近所の、絶対、老婆、絶対、お話、絶対、よく、絶対、聞かせてくださるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, the neighbor's grandmother tells me stories all the time, and I really do love hearing them.
lines.style: Tender, reflective. A warmth in remembering her. Slower pace, like she's savoring the thought. Soft on the edges — genuine affection for the older woman.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、バルト、絶対、三国、絶対、行ってみたいよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, wouldn't it be cool to actually go visit the Baltic countries someday?
lines.style: Eager, open curiosity. A little brightness — he's imagining something. Direct and hopeful. Not tentative, just young and reaching. Leaning forward in the voice.
